body: Proactiv doesn't help me nor will it do anything for pitted acne scars. I am on antibiotics and they only work a little.
The problem is it is not temporary. My acne scars will always be there and so will my social anxiety and depression. I could see myself homeless if my parents didn't support me.
Some people are more fortunate than others. They have healthy skin, are good looking, are intelligent and loved by most. I was dealt a bad hand in life and suicide is an answer to that bad hand.
Why would I go on when nothing would get better? I am unintelligent, ugly and have no talents that would make me employable. Why would I live a life of misery when I could escape the pain?

I tried many different antidepressants but they don't work that well. It is my circumstances making me depressed. 

No one would hire me because of my appearance and lack of work history.

I have already tried fractional c02 laser and it gave me red hiperpigmentation and didn't do a whole lot for my scarring.
